paragraphs.source_en: To Sekiguchi Gyōbu-shōyū, the first month of the second year of Kōji was a month filled with joy and hope. As soon as the customary New Year’s greetings were over, he returned to his residence and cast a fortune for his future son-in-law, Jirōsaburō. A remark Yoshimoto had made moments earlier had left him somewhat uneasy, but the divination showed that his fears were groundless.
